    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':

    for i in range(6):
        if not step('UP'): break
    print('at (20,20) pos', barpos())
# Phase 3: left to col16, down to row40
if step('LEFT'):
    for i in range(6):
        if not step('DOWN'): break
    print('at (40,16) pos', barpos())
print('final pos', barpos(), 'timer', [n['pixels'] for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N'])
</parameter>
